exposure: Human milk oligosaccharide (HMO) concentrations (3FL, LNFPIII, LNFPII)
Infant daily HMO intakes (LNFPII, DFLNT, DFLNH)
cohort: The study included 56 mother-infant dyads from the Western Australian BLOSOM cohort, consisting of predominantly (n=2) and exclusively (n=54) breastfed infants.
finding: The study demonstrated statistically significant but biologically limited associations between specific human milk oligosaccharide concentrations and intakes and the composition of the infant oral microbiome.
